newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Slight thickening near St Petersburg.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Slight thickening near St Petersburg.

text.p: Ice thickened slightly around St Petersburg but there were no major changes elsewhere and no new navigation restrictions were planned in Finnish waters, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Thursday.

Three icebreakers were on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, one near Porvoo and Lovii, four in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, two in the middle, and one outside Rauma.
One ice-breaker remained on station in the Gulf of Riga.
PORT TEMP ICE TYPE THICKNESS RESTRICTIONS
St Petersburg n/a Level/compact/ 30-50 Russian ice class 13,
Rauma n/a Fast/open/ 10-35 Ice classes I, II,
Oulu n/a Fast/compact/ 40-65 Ice class IA,
Kemi n/a Windrow/rafted/ 40-80 Ice class IA
Lulea n/a Level 25-40 Ice class IB,
Kokkola n/a Level/compact 40-55 Ice class IA,
Ornskoldsvik n/a Fast 10-15 Ice class II,
NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice -
not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice.
Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped
by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming,
10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes
with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
